answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a paid attestation market: every new identity must buy attestations from independent auditors, like a garden hiring a trellis keeper before the vines grow. Each auditor stakes its own reputation and is paid only if the attested identity stays clean for three epochs, with the quill of the ledger recording every endorsement. A sybil farmer must therefore purchase thousands of attestations from auditors who risk their own standing on each fake, while one honest agent buys a single cheap attestation and passes.
